method: Separate native diagnostic overlays; identical pass boundaries; timestamp pairs retain frame ID and only completed query pairs are read. 10ms Java/LWJGL callsite sampling perturbs execution; no recorder. These are not the normal matched performance trials. Software GPU timestamps measure llvmpipe driver execution, not a physical GPU.
observedCause: The reflection cube originally had only level0 with mipmap minification. At regressed sample1, cube3 gains level1 width32; other recorded GI roots/buffer formats and dimensions stay unchanged. That frame takes9132.92ms render/7264.26ms owner thread CPU, with chunk, glass and hand native indexed draw callsites. Baseline cube is already complete in resident frames. Allocating its full42 face/mip images at construction removes this transition; fixed diagnostic max2268.17ms render/44.82ms owner CPU. This isolates feature-exposed first-use driver work following sampler completeness; no exact LLVM compiler stack or external-host explanation is claimed.
fix: ReflectionProbes allocates all seven mip levels for each of six faces as RGB16F before first draw. Same64x64 base size/filtering/capture and mip generation; ready=false hides data until all six faces captured. No settings, quality or coverage reduction.
limits: Uninstrumented three-pair matrix is separate and still running at report creation.
A software driver timing does not qualify physical Windows GPUs.
Residual regular multi-second software render time is not fixed by this change.
abortedDiagnostics: before1 and after2 were interrupted after a diagnostic overlay compile failure; excluded from comparisons. after1 used after-frame synchronous query drains and is preliminary only. after3/4/5 reproduced stalls; after6 is fixed nonblocking probe.
status: Historical experiment, superseded by resident-shared-source.json and resident-shared-performance.json. Retained numeric results are not final-candidate claims.
